data.long_meaning: In the Sesotho language, Lerato means 'rejoice' or 'delight'. This beautiful and meaningful name has its roots in African spirituality and is often given to girls to symbolize the joy and love that surrounds them. The name Lerato carries the meaning “Rejoice, Delight, Love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Sesotho. Parents who choose Lerato usually hope their child will grow to embody rejoice, delight, love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
